etymology.historical_story: The packet provides no recoverable history for this token. A separately attested use is the name Kurisu Makise in Steins;Gate, documented by an official merchandise manufacturer. Assigning a Japanese spelling, a surname origin, or a Malay meaning would therefore exceed the available evidence. [Good Smile Company](https://www.goodsmile.com/en/product/1130/Kurisu%2BMakise)
